blocks.text: BRUSSELS, Belgium—European Union (EU) chief Antonio Costa believes it is time to raise the pressure on Russia and support for Kyiv, rallying behind Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky as tensions spike with Washington. “This is no time to withdraw the support to Ukraine.
